text:
María: quick idea — instead of a single big demo for the next webinar, what if we run two simultaneous microbreakouts: 1) Benchmark storytelling + cost/latency lesson, 2) Hands-on integration lab (30min). short intros, then attendees pick a track. thoughts?

Sam G: love this. gives engineering folks a clear CTA. main worry = support headcount for labs. we need 2-3 engineers in the lab channel and one floater. :raised_hands:

Priya R: agree — abstracts should signal expected audience: "Benchmarks for product teams" vs "Integration lab for engineers (SDK + infra)". i'll draft two 2-sentence abstracts.

Chris - Prod: schedule/rehearsal implications: need a rehearsal with speakers + demo engineers 48h before. run-of-show gets extra handoff steps when we split tracks. also recommend short pre-recorded fallback for each demo.

Jenna M: routing plan — during signup we ask "Which track are you likely to join?" then route registrants to track-specific follow-ups. use distinct calendar slots so we can route leads to SDRs by interest.

María: good. for fallback logic we should publish a short note: "If live demo fails we'll play prerecorded + open Q&A". keeps expectations clear.

Sam G: for the lab, we should provide a dockerized quickstart or a hosted notebook. if we do hosted notebook, need an auth checklist (no creds in demos).

Priya R: draft abstracts (2 sentences each):
- Benchmarks: "How we measure and optimize LLM inference economics — real-world benchmarks, tradeoffs between latency and unit cost, and prescriptive levers for production."
- Integration Lab: "Hands-on lab: get Redwood running in your stack — SDK walkthrough, routing rules, and performance tuning tips. Bring a laptop. Basic infra knowledge required."

Chris - Prod: rehearsal checklist (quick):
```
- Speaker tech check (mic, slides)
- Demo engineer infra check (access, tokens, pre-warm)
- Run fallback pre-record for each track
- Moderator script with handoffs and watchlist
- 48h full dress + 1h quick check 1h before
```

Jenna M: lead routing mapping idea: benchmark leads -> product/value SDR; lab leads -> solutions/engineering SDR. add a hidden form field for "demo logs" willingness (willing to share small prompts/metrics) so we can route to RE's customer success for trials.

María: timeline: finalize abstracts by Wed, confirm speakers by Fri, rehearsal next Wed. can people who volunteer for lab support react below?

Sam G: me, and i can bring Anil from infra.

Priya R: i'll own abstracts + speaker briefing doc. linking draft in drive: https://drive.google.com/example (will update today).

Chris - Prod: i'll schedule rehearsals and add calendar invites. calendar-bot: reminder set for 2025-07-02 16:00?

calendar-bot: Reminder created: "Webinar full dress rehearsal" on 2025-07-02 16:00 UTC.

Jenna M: i'll draft signup page copy and track-specific CTAs. first pass up by tomorrow. :rocket:

María: perfect — short follow-ups only. want this to be engineer-friendly and measurable (NPS + conversions by track). thank you! :sparkles:
